remediated_proposal: Use FIXED_MA200_QQQ_TO_QLD as the sole PRIMARY PROSPECTIVE MODEL
rationale: Preserves the accepted simple rule and avoids adding degrees of freedom
selection_bias_control: No new model or parameter may be introduced after observations

current_draft_rule: Phase7A could be retained as a comparator
remediated_proposal: Retain PHASE7A only as a NON-DECISION SHADOW COMPARATOR
rationale: Separates complexity context from the primary evidence
selection_bias_control: It cannot replace the primary model or create a deployment decision

current_draft_rule: Phase7B was historical context
remediated_proposal: Keep Phase7B Model A and Model B historical context only
rationale: No walk-forward selection is repeated prospectively
selection_bias_control: Historical context cannot enter the prospective candidate set

current_draft_rule: Four schedules were proposed without an inferential role
remediated_proposal: Propose WEEKLY as exactly one PRIMARY_PROSPECTIVE_SCHEDULE
rationale: Weekly provides denser operational feedback and faster detection of calendar or execution defects using only prospective-design considerations
selection_bias_control: The role is declared before observations and is not ranked by return

current_draft_rule: All four schedules were to be run without a primary distinction
remediated_proposal: Retain MONTHLY BIMONTHLY and QUARTERLY as ROBUSTNESS_SHADOW_SCHEDULE
rationale: Shadows expose schedule sensitivity without multiplying confirmatory opportunities
selection_bias_control: Shadow results cannot promote a schedule or trigger PASS

current_draft_rule: No start timestamp was frozen
remediated_proposal: Activate only after external audit final freeze implementation audit and uncounted dry-run
rationale: Protects the unseen boundary and prevents start-date movement
selection_bias_control: Start reset or historical data reuse invalidates the protocol

current_draft_rule: Timezone and holiday handling were not operationally frozen
remediated_proposal: Use America/New_York and one official U.S. exchange-session calendar
rationale: Aligns close and next-open events reproducibly
selection_bias_control: Calendar changes after start are protocol invalid

current_draft_rule: Vendor and revision handling were unresolved
remediated_proposal: Use an authoritative timestamped adjusted/unadjusted feed plus an independent backup reconciliation feed
rationale: Preserves source traceability and prevents silent substitution
selection_bias_control: Source identity and hashes are fixed before first observation

current_draft_rule: The prior draft allowed an unresolved skip or hold choice
remediated_proposal: Fail closed with an incident; no interpolation forward fill synthetic or favorable price; stale after 15 minutes is an incident
rationale: Prevents missing data from creating favorable execution
selection_bias_control: Every exception is append-only and cannot rewrite prior observations

current_draft_rule: Close-t then next-open was accepted but needed operational detail
remediated_proposal: Use adjusted QQQ close at t and earliest eligible U.S. open after t; never same-day
rationale: Preserves the information boundary and avoids lookahead
selection_bias_control: Any close or same-day substitution is protocol invalid

current_draft_rule: Research baseline was 0 commission and 5 bps slippage
remediated_proposal: Retain 0 bps commission and 5 bps slippage as MODEL_ASSUMPTION; report observable fills separately
rationale: Maintains economic comparability and distinguishes model from diagnostic
selection_bias_control: Retuning the assumption after observations is prohibited

current_draft_rule: No numerical execution tolerance was frozen
remediated_proposal: p95 observed absolute slippage <=25 bps and p95 tracking difference <=50 bps
rationale: Conservative implementation tolerances set before data exist
selection_bias_control: Thresholds are not selected from historical outcomes

current_draft_rule: No latency tolerance was frozen
remediated_proposal: Signal-to-order <=5 minutes and order-to-fill <=15 minutes
rationale: Allows ordinary logging and market-open operations while flagging material delay
selection_bias_control: Timing limits are fixed before observations

current_draft_rule: The draft did not require window-level evidence
remediated_proposal: Record first valid MA date pre-start observations lookback start evaluation start and missing aligned targets; create no pre-start equity or trade
rationale: Audits information availability without adding a trade
selection_bias_control: Warm-up diagnostics cannot alter a signal or path

current_draft_rule: Duration used time and event intersections
remediated_proposal: Use a finite 36-calendar-month core horizon with mandatory evaluation
rationale: Three years gives a bounded prospective design while preserving uncertainty
selection_bias_control: The clock cannot be reset or silently extended

current_draft_rule: The draft proposed fixed counts of observations episodes and adverse events
remediated_proposal: Assess >=500 valid paired daily sessions plus reconstructable weekly records and observed mechanism information; absence may be INCONCLUSIVE
rationale: Separates information adequacy from arbitrary crossing counts
selection_bias_control: No favorable subset or forced crossing is used

current_draft_rule: No finite post-inconclusive rule was defined
remediated_proposal: Permit one fixed 12-calendar-month extension only after INCONCLUSIVE; end at 48 months from original start
rationale: Provides one bounded chance to add information without an open-ended experiment
selection_bias_control: No parameter threshold frequency or start reset and no repeated extension

current_draft_rule: Scheduled observations episodes and regime events were conflated
remediated_proposal: Report scheduled observations target-state changes completed episodes and adverse/regime transitions as separate counts
rationale: Prevents event-count substitution and clarifies evidence roles
selection_bias_control: No arbitrary count is required to force PASS

current_draft_rule: QQQ buy-and-hold was the accepted benchmark
remediated_proposal: Use QQQ buy-and-hold on identical dates capital calendar valuation and provenance
rationale: Maintains the frozen comparison
selection_bias_control: Changing benchmark or dates invalidates evidence

current_draft_rule: The draft had no auditable primary statistic
remediated_proposal: Test weekly Fixed MA200 versus QQQ paired daily excess d_t in the predicted positive direction while requiring no unacceptable implementation or drawdown degradation
rationale: Addresses faithful unseen execution rather than CAGR alone
selection_bias_control: One hypothesis is fixed before observations and no secondary winner is added

current_draft_rule: The method was left for later audit
remediated_proposal: Use Newey-West HAC mean-excess inference with L=min(20 floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9))); two-sided 95% CI and one-sided alpha .05 if adequate
rationale: Accounts for serial dependence and makes uncertainty explicit
selection_bias_control: No prospective statistic or p-value is calculated in this remediation

current_draft_rule: Four frequencies could become four winner tests
remediated_proposal: Only weekly is confirmatory; the three shadows are descriptive and cannot trigger PASS
rationale: Minimizes unnecessary multiplicity while retaining robustness evidence
selection_bias_control: No post-result frequency ranking or adjustment choice

current_draft_rule: Original Goals A B and C were historical objectives
remediated_proposal: Keep Goal A/B/C unchanged; propose MaxDD < -60% or drawdown difference < -10 percentage points as hard risk failures
rationale: Conservative prospective governance does not redefine historical goals
selection_bias_control: No dominance claim is made from return alone

current_draft_rule: No prospective burden limit was frozen
remediated_proposal: Annual turnover <=6.0x using contemporaneous pretrade equity and excluding initial deployment and terminal liquidation
rationale: Controls implementation burden while preserving canonical metric
selection_bias_control: Threshold is not calibrated to an observed outcome

current_draft_rule: Tax reporting was described but not gated
remediated_proposal: Retain 20.315% average-cost immediate realized-tax ledger and non-mutating terminal diagnostic; reconcile NAV and tax within $0.01
rationale: Preserves accepted accounting and catches ledger drift
selection_bias_control: No tax treatment may change after start

current_draft_rule: Operational and economic failure were mixed
remediated_proposal: Separate PROTOCOL_INVALID, PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATION_FAIL, PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATION_INCONCLUSIVE, and PASS
rationale: Invalid evidence is not an economic loss and insufficient evidence is not failure
selection_bias_control: Each state has a fixed trigger and cannot be relabeled after results

current_draft_rule: Interim performance could influence duration
remediated_proposal: Monitor only protocol invalidation incidents and predeclared severe risk; no early-success rule
rationale: Protects the fixed horizon and prevents outcome stopping
selection_bias_control: No routine performance reset or early success is permitted

current_draft_rule: Change control was generic
remediated_proposal: Any strategy data benchmark start frequency or threshold change creates a new protocol commit tag and audit
rationale: Preserves an auditable boundary
selection_bias_control: No silent rewrite or restart after results

current_draft_rule: Paper validation was not live authorization
remediated_proposal: SMALL_CAPITAL_LIVE_VALIDATION is a separate future protocol after external/manual audit
rationale: Separates evidence from deployment
selection_bias_control: No live capital or automatic promotion is authorized
